text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-2026-euW - elevated 5xx rate on /v1/embeddings (eu-west1). Alert threshold 0.8% -> current 3.4% over 5m. Metrics: https://monitoring.redwood.ai/alerts/PD-2026 :rotating_light:
alex: Acked via PagerDuty. I'm on it.
jamie: Looking at traces - most are 502 from edge-proxy -> upstream timeout to model-router. RTs spiking, retries visible.
maria: Any customer-visible failures?
alex: Yes — embeddings calls timing out for interactive customers, bulk ingest retries failing. Support flagged a few major customers.
ops-aoife: I see a config roll earlier tonight on edge-proxy (canary) in eu-west1. Rollout at 02:12 UTC.
jamie: Can confirm header timeout change in proxy config: upstream_timeout=5s -> increased 2s in canary. That seems to amplify retries.
sre_lead: If proxy change caused retry storms we should rollback canary and scale while we investigate.
alex: Agreed. Rolling back proxy canary in eu-west1 now. Command:
```bash
kubectl --context=eu-west1 -n platform rollout undo deployment/edge-proxy --to-revision=3
```
ops-aoife: Scaling edge-proxy replicas while rollback completes:
```bash
kubectl --context=eu-west1 -n platform scale deployment/edge-proxy --replicas=6
```
pagerduty: PD-2026 acknowledged by alex. Auto-escalation disabled for acknowledged incidents.
jamie: I pushed a short circuit on retries for embeddings route to reduce tail load (temporary): config change applied.
alex: curl sanity check against origin:
```bash
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings | head -n1
```
jamie: After rollback + scale + retry cut, 5xx rate dropping: 3.4% -> 1.1% in 90s, errors concentrated on a handful of proxy pods that are being drained.
support-lee: Logged customer impact: 9 active ingestion jobs failed, 4 interactive customers reported timeouts. CS notified: TKT-4581, TKT-4582, TKT-4583.
maria: Thanks — we'll attach monitoring snapshot and ETA to each ticket.
sre_lead: Good mitigation. Next steps: keep rollback while we validate new proxy timeout defaults in staging, revert canary, add guardrail to prevent upstream_timeout regression.
jamie: Will open follow-up RFC and postmortem link.
alex: I'll close PD once stable for 10m and error rate <0.5%. Keeping channel open for 30m monitoring.
incident-bot: PD-2026 status: acknowledged by alex; incident tagged "investigating".
ops-aoife: All eu-west1 proxy pods back to healthy after draining the bad ones.
jamie: Verified end-to-end traces look normal. 5xx now 0.4% over last 5m.
alex: PD-2026 resolved in PagerDuty (closing) — we'll open a follow-up postmortem. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident closed by alex. Notes: rollback edge-proxy canary + scale + retry short-circuit. Postmortem: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/PD-2026
